thread:
Alex (oncall): quick evening sync — leaving a short handover. TL;DR: embeddings error spike in prod (~E-304), applied rolling restart + enabled KV cache fallback, alerts temporarily suppressed while we validate. regulatory-test cluster hit a CPU thrash but autoscaler kept it within SLOs.

Sam G: where's the runbook for E-304? want the checklist before I sign off.

Alex (oncall): runbook here: https://confluence.redwood/ops/embed-incidents E-304 section. key cmds I ran: 
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embed-worker --context=prod-cluster
curl -sS https://prod-inference/api/v1/health | jq .status
```
logs showed repeated OOM-ish eviction spikes before restart: 
```
[2026-03-17T18:10:12Z] embed-worker-3 OOMKill: killed process 2345 (torch) RSS 12GB
[2026-03-17T18:10:13Z] evicting KV cache prefix user-requests/seq=...
```

Rachel: did the restart clear the errors? any impact to latency?

Alex (oncall): post-restart error rate dropped to baseline within 7m. p50/p95 latency + small bump for ~2m during warmup then back to normal. I left a temporary traffic marker to route small percentage to embed-worker-v2 (older variant) as fallback if we see a regression.

deploy-bot: embed-service v2.3.7 deployed to prod by @Alex (oncall) — checks passed :white_check_mark:

Sam G: ok thx. I'll run a quick canary suite now. ping me if anything weird shows.

Omar: I'll keep pager for the next hour, then @Rachel covers overnight. any special alerts I should mute/keep?

Alex (oncall): left these alerts suppressed for 30m: alerts/embed/error-rate, alerts/embed/oom. keep alerts/embed/latency active. check these dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/embedded/embeds-overview and the prefix eviction chart.

Rachel: noted, I'll watch latency and run a 50-request smoke with these prompts: (1) search: "find docs on kvcache" (2) summarize doc: short. if we see >2% failures escalate.

Sam G: can you paste the smoke command you use?

Rachel: sure — quick curl example: 
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -X POST https://prod-inference/api/v1/embed -d '{"text":"find docs on kvcache"}' | jq .status; done | sort | uniq -c
```

Alex (oncall): left a TODO: follow up with infra-team tomorrow to investigate memory pressure pattern (possible mem leak in latest op kernel). ticket: INF-1129. Also note we should test quantized variant in staging before next deploy.

Omar: got it. I'll add a short check to the morning rota to validate KV cache hit rate >90% after 08:00 PDT.

Alex (oncall): final notes / action items: 
- Watch latency dashboard for next 45m (Rachel)
- Sam to verify runbook steps and close E-304 if green
- Omar to own overnight pager until 19:30 PT then hand to Rachel
- Infra to triage INF-1129 tomorrow

Thanks team — leaving context in the incident doc, ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
